name: collectd
description: Collectd RRD reader + live UDP listener + Realm Census panel. Provides per-host metric summaries and a grouped node list.

rrd_path.description: Path to collectd RRD data directory

udp_port.description: UDP port for collectd network protocol listener

cli.summary: Per-host metric summaries from collectd (Realm Census)

verbs.name: show
verbs.summary: Snapshot of every host with recent collectd metrics
verbs.table: (.hosts // .) | (if type=="object" then to_entries | map(.value + {host: .key}) else . end) | .[] | [.host // "-", (.cpu // "-" | tostring), (.load // "-" | tostring), (.mem_pct // .mem // "-" | tostring), (.uptime // "-" | tostring)]
